Product Description

Fruit of the Loom Men's Classic White Tanks are comfortable and versatile as an every day undershirt. They are made with super-soft, 100% cotton ribbed fabric, providing a cool and comfortable fit that forms to your shape. These a-shirts have generous length that stay tucked in all day and keep you comfortable in every situation. These sleeveless undershirts are comfortable and light enough to be worn as an extra layer without adding extra warmth to an outfit. Each undershirt wicks away moisture so you can stay cool and dry.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find these tank tops to be good quality undershirts that are comfortable, particularly in hot weather, and appreciate their soft light fabric and good value for money. The length receives mixed feedback - while some find it long enough to stay tucked in, others say it's too long. The material quality also gets mixed reviews, with some praising the good quality cotton while others find it cheap.

    Incredibly comfortable, great fit, and keeps you perfectly cool!
    Reviewed in the United States on June 9, 2026
    Color: 6 Pack WhiteSize: Large
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I am absolutely thrilled with this pack of Fruit of the Loom sleeveless tank A-shirts! If you are looking for the perfect everyday undershirt or a reliable tank for working out, these are an absolute home run.

    The material is incredibly soft and lightweight, providing a comfortable, breathable layer that doesn't feel bulky under a button-down or hoodie. The tag-free design is a total game-changer—zero annoying scratching or irritation at the back of the neck. What really stands out is the moisture-wicking technology; it does a spectacular job of keeping you cool and dry even on hot days or during heavy activity.

    They fit perfectly right out of the package, offering a classic fit that hugs the body naturally without feeling restrictive or loose. Even after multiple trips through the washer and dryer, they hold their shape beautifully, don't shrink awkwardly, and maintain their clean finish. Getting this many high-quality, durable tanks for such an affordable price is an amazing value. Highly recommended!

    5 out of 5 stars
    A good buy
    Reviewed in the United States on April 12, 2026
    Color: 6 Pack WhiteSize: Large
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    My son has gone through a lot of undershirts over the years and these Fruit of the Loom tanks are genuinely our favorites. Nothing fancy, just does everything right.

    The tag free situation alone is worth it. I don't know why anyone still puts tags in undershirts. But the fact that this one doesn't have one is an instant win. No itching, no irritation, or me having to be cutting out the tags, just put it on and forget about it.

    I've washed them many times and they still look and feel great and no weird shrinking, no fabric going all wonky. That's all I ask for honestly.

    And for the price you really can't go wrong. If you need a solid everyday undershirt that just works, this is it. Simple as that.

About this Item

  • 6 Pack
  • Classic Tank Undershirt
  • Sleeveless
  • Soft Ribbed Fabric Forms to Your Shape
  • Cool and Comfortable Fit
  • Soft and Durable

Product Description

Our men's classic white A-shirts are comfortable and versatile. They are made with super-soft, 100% cotton ribbed fabric, providing a cool and comfortable fit that forms to your shape. These tank undershirts have generous length so they stay tucked all day, keeping you comfortable in every situation. They are sleeveless, so they may be used easily as undershirts or worn on their own. They are comfortable and light enough to be worn as an undershirt without adding extra warmth to an outfit. These tanks wick moisture away to help keep you stay cool and dry.
